segments.name: Manufacturing and servicing of wafer processing semiconductor manufacturing equi
segments.description: Supplies wafer fabrication equipment and services in deposition, etch, and clean markets to semiconductor memory, foundry, and integrated device manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable business segment: manufacturing and servicing of wafer processing semiconductor manufacturing equipment.

revenueModel.text: Semiconductor manufacturers pay Lam for new leading-edge wafer fabrication equipment plus customer support-related revenue including customer service, spares, upgrades, and non-leading-edge Reliant equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: Systems revenue includes sales of new leading-edge equipment in deposition, etch, clean and other water fabrication markets. Customer support-related revenue includes sales of customer service, spares, upgrades, and non-leading-edge equipment from the Company's Reliant® product line.
